verdict.rationale: Orama's AnswerSession feature explicitly delivers ChatGPT-like AI-generated answers with sources drawn from the user's own indexed data, and Orama Cloud extends this with AI-powered NLP search and RAG-oriented data sources/projects, directly matching the ask for in-product AI-generated insights. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of answer quality, and no explicit evidence of proactive 'suggestions' beyond Q&A-style answers.
